notes.title: Lust Academy Final is OUT NOW + 2 DLCs + Special Bundles!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43076813/d7bf3d47c0682963e9ec2af20bc69ac1b2ef9533.png[/img]
[b]Hello, magical friends![/b]
We’re thrilled to announce that [b]Lust Academy Final is now available![/b]

Get ready for the hottest, most dangerous chapter yet. The Overlord is on the move, the Academy is under threat—and your choices will decide who lives, who dies… and who ends up in your bed.

[b]What’s waiting for you:[/b]
[list]
[*] A fiery new adventure with deepened relationships and intense choices
[*] The challenge of strengthening the Academy against a rising darkness
[*] Building powerful alliances with mythical beings
[*] New sandbox elements and enhanced quest systems
[*] Hotter, steamier relationships than ever before!
[/list]
[b]New DLCs Available:[/b]
[list]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3626060/Lust_Academy_Season_4__Beyond_the_Veil/]Beyond the Veil[/url] — More intimate moments, renders, animations, Lustogram pictures, mini-comics, and the official soundtracks!
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3625630/Lust_Academy_Season_4__Shadows_Unleashed/]Shadows Unleashed [/url]— A thrilling new story beyond Cordale, full of mystery, peril... and intense passion.
[/list]
[b]Bundles to Explore with the special prices:[/b]
[list]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/51879/Lust_Academy_4_in_1/]Lust Academy 4-in-1 Bundle [/url]— All Seasons 1–4 together!
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/51884/Lust_Academy_S4_Complete_Edition/]Lust Academy Final: Complete Edition [/url]— Base Game + Beyond the Veil DLC!
[/list]
[b]Jump into the magic, intrigue, and seduction of Lust Academy now![/b]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3230990?utm_source=SteamNews style=button] [b]PLAY NOW[/b][/url]

notes.title: Fixes 27.06 (English grammar and Puzzle game)
notes.content:
Hey guys!
We are here with a bunch of fixes and improvements:

- Next part of English grammar and overall quality improvements [i](I would say almost all game proofread)[/i]
- Puzzle game improvements ([i]now it should be comfortable to play in it)[/i]
- Some game bugs and game logic fixes
- Minor sounds and other fixes

Thanks for staying with us!

We always read your comments and try to improve every aspect of our game :)
